_about: Default values for Belgian legal, tax and payroll rules used by the model, each with its official source and the date it was last checked. Explanation: belgian-rules.md. Update procedure: skills/fp-rules-check/SKILL.md. A plan can override any value in plan-data.json (rules + rules_sources) without changing this file.

reduced_rate_min_director_pay.note: Law of 15 July 2026 (Belgian Official Gazette 29/07/2026): €50,000, indexed yearly, from assessment year 2027 (€51,000 indexed for AY 2027, according to Attentia; official indexed amount to be confirmed). Only applies from the fifth taxable period after incorporation.

reduced_rate_pay_condition_from_period.note: Art. 215, third paragraph, 4° WIB 92: the minimum-remuneration condition applies 'vanaf het vijfde belastbaar tijdperk vanaf hun oprichting'.

employer_ssc_rate.note: Estimate for white-collar staff incl. small sector contributions; blue-collar is higher. A payroll simulation is better.

vat_exemption.note: Threshold 25,000; not supported by the model.

company_contribution.note: Amounts for 2026: small = balance total up to 879,163.44, large = above. Reform to 4 levels pending.

company_contribution_exemption.note: Exempt during the first 3 years of the company's existence, counted from the year of incorporation, for all companies except NV, registered in the KBO, when the directors (and the majority of active non-director partners) were self-employed for no more than 12 quarters in the 40 quarters before incorporation (side activity and helper included).

self_employed_contributions.note: 2026 values for the self-employed in main occupation, without the social insurance fund's administration costs (about 3-4% depending on the fund). Contributions are calculated on the director's net taxable professional income; the minimum applies below the minimum income. Primostarters pay a reduced minimum during their first 4 quarters.
